versions.content: The Ea module shall call the function defined in the configuration parameter EaNvMJobErrorNotification upon failure of an asynchronous write operation after performing all necessary internal management and error handling operations. Failure of an asynchronous write operation implies the write job is finished and has failed and block has been marked as inconsistent.
